_: The realm's gold mines in the view (gold_mines.gd): a mine stands on every gold seam the bridge reports, worked by miners when the camera is near; where a seam ran out, the old workings stand dark and empty. Where the gold is and how long it lasts is Freeciv's (bridge/data/mines.json). on: false (or --gold-mines=off) shows none. scale: the mine's size against its true metres. off: where on the tile it stands, in tiles from the centre. miners: how many work a live seam; ring: how far from the mine they stand (world units); clips: what they do, swapped every swap_sec; near: the camera distance (world units) inside which miners are about. spent_shade: how dark the old workings are (0 none, 1 black).
